trigger_condition: Existing interactive usage `codemie assistants setup --agent claude` at a TTY
guard_snippet: isHeadlessMode: trigger only on yes/assistant/skill, not on agent/scope/mode alone
potential_consequence: Previously working interactive run now aborts: 'Missing required flag: --assistant'

trigger_condition: `codemie skills setup --agent claude` (or --scope only) at a TTY
guard_snippet: require an explicit --yes/--skill before switching to the headless branch
potential_consequence: Interactive skill selection becomes unreachable; command fails demanding --skill

trigger_condition: Headless run via host-agent wiring, e.g. codemie-claude, without --agent
potential_consequence: hostAgent ignored; per-agent shortcut invocations fail despite an unambiguous target

trigger_condition: Headless skills run under a host agent without an explicit --agent flag
potential_consequence: hostAgent parameter accepted but unused; run aborts with a misleading flag error

guard_snippet: throw new ConfigurationError('--project/--all-projects are not supported with --assistant')
potential_consequence: Project filter silently ignored; name resolution spans projects the user excluded

trigger_condition: Requested assistant is marketplace-only, not VISIBLE_TO_USER scope
guard_snippet: also page API_SCOPE.MARKETPLACE and merge before resolveIdentifiers
potential_consequence: Valid marketplace assistant reported as 'No assistant found matching', unregisterable headlessly

trigger_condition: Large visible catalog; per_page is CONFIG.ITEMS_PER_PAGE (5), no page cap
guard_snippet: use per_page: 100 and cap iterations (e.g. if (page > MAX_PAGES) break;)
potential_consequence: Hundreds of sequential API calls per run; inflated `pages` loops unbounded

trigger_condition: listPaginated called with no filters/scope, unlike interactive project/marketplace fetch
guard_snippet: pass filters: { search:'', scope:'project' } and also page marketplace scope
potential_consequence: Headless catalog omits skills the interactive picker shows; identifiers wrongly not found

trigger_condition: Two catalog entries share a slug (or id) across projects
guard_snippet: collect slug/id buckets and throw AmbiguousIdentifierError when length > 1
potential_consequence: Silently registers whichever duplicate came last; wrong assistant installed

trigger_condition: loadRegisteredAssistants merges GLOBAL+LOCAL; --scope names only one
potential_consequence: Other-scope registrations copied into the chosen config file; duplicated, unresolvable records

trigger_condition: Registered skill has no .claude/skills/<slug>/SKILL.md (codex- or gemini-only target)
guard_snippet: load raw config skills for the reconcile list instead of file-verified loadSkillsByScope
potential_consequence: Those entries silently dropped from the saved config; codex/gemini artifacts orphaned

trigger_condition: Second of three items fails; PartialRegistrationError aborts before any save
guard_snippet: persist results written so far (partial save) before rethrowing PartialRegistrationError
potential_consequence: Files written on disk have no config record; later unregister cannot remove them

trigger_condition: unregisterAssistant still uses non-strict executeWithSpinner and swallows failures
guard_snippet: await executeWithSpinnerStrict(...) in unregisterAssistant, or check its result before saving
potential_consequence: Failed removal reported as unregistered; stale subagent/skill files keep resolving

trigger_condition: unregisterSkill swallows errors, yet re-register path assumes removal succeeded
guard_snippet: make unregisterSkill strict and abort the run when removal fails
potential_consequence: Stale skill directory survives; config claims the new slug/targets only

trigger_condition: Re-registering with --agent narrower than the record's stored agentTargets
potential_consequence: Artifacts for dropped targets remain on disk, permanently orphaned from config

trigger_condition: Two headless runs write the same scope config concurrently (scripted, xargs -P)
guard_snippet: serialize config writes with a lockfile around load-modify-save
potential_consequence: Last writer wins; the other run's registrations vanish from config

trigger_condition: Guard rejected a falsy slug returned by the skill generators
guard_snippet: if (!result) throw new Error(`Skill ${skill.name} produced no slug`); before building the record
potential_consequence: Record persisted with undefined/empty slug; unregister later targets a wrong path

trigger_condition: Skipped a selected assistant missing from the fetched set, keeping the run alive
guard_snippet: skip-and-warn in the interactive path; throw only in the headless branch
potential_consequence: Interactive multi-select now aborts mid-run after unregistering, leaving nothing saved
